proof_body:
by
  intro R L _ _ _ I hI hQ
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := LieAlgebra.IsSolvable.solvable R (L ⧸ I)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := LieAlgebra.IsSolvable.solvable R I
  let π : L →ₗ⁅R⁆ L ⧸ I := { (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk' I : L →ₗ[R] L ⧸ I) with map_lie' := fun {x y} => LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_bracket I x y }
  have hπ : Function.Surjective π := LieSubmodule.Quotient.surjective_mk' I
  have h1 : LieAlgebra.derivedSeries R L l ≤ I := by
    have h2 : LieIdeal.map π (LieAlgebra.derivedSeries R L l) = ⊥ := by
      rw [LieIdeal.derivedSeries_map_eq l hπ, hl]
    rw [LieIdeal.map_eq_bot_iff] at h2
    intro x hx
    have h3 := h2 hx
    rw [LieHom.mem_ker] at h3
    exact (LieSubmodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (N := I)).mp h3
  rw [LieIdeal.derivedSeries_eq_bot_iff] at hk
  refine LieAlgebra.IsSolvable.mk (R := R) (k := k + l) ?_
  rw [LieAlgebra.derivedSeries_def, LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_add]
  exact eq_bot_iff.mpr (hk ▸ LieAlgebra.derivedSeriesOfIdeal_mono h1 k)
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) (L : Type*) [CommRing R] [LieRing L] [LieAlgebra R L] (I : LieIdeal R L), LieAlgebra.IsSolvable I → LieAlgebra.IsSolvable (L ⧸ I) → LieAlgebra.IsSolvable L
